title: Post-synthesis chemical-state-negative qualification of a genotype-linked library
statement: The selected XH1 source proposes a downstream chemical-state-negative filter for a completed genotype-linked library of ribosomally generated nonstandard cyclic peptides: exposed hydrazinyl nitrogen on a linear uncyclized product could be marked/removed while the correctly cyclized product has consumed that group. This is a proposal only; compatible selective capture/display on intact mRNA fusions and the integrated workflow are unacquired.

requires: Existing ribosomal nonstandard peptide synthesis and mRNA-display linkage are credited prior operations, not contributions of this proposal.
The 22% ring fraction is an observed example for one substrate only and must not be transferred to the separate double-ring Figure 8 experiment.
Distinct chemical commands in a shared pool require distinguishable codon/charged-tRNA decoding registers; two mRNAs do not independently select different monomers charged to the same codon.
provides: A candidate post-synthesis product-quality filter to qualify genotype-linked libraries before functional selection.
A substrate-specific algebraic selectivity requirement: for p=.22 and q>=.99, wrong/correct retention must satisfy w/t<=.002849; this is arithmetic, not measured discrimination.
assumptions: The desired ring consumes the exposed hydrazinyl group while the cited linear product retains it.
Any selective tagging must preserve the intact genotype/product linkage and avoid false tagging of other groups; these are unacquired hypotheses.
The puromycin-linked mRNA/product fusion is a consumed library object, not a reusable assembly catalyst. Arbitrary late per-chain instruction rewriting is not supplied.
costs: No wet-lab compatibility, chemical selectivity, capture recovery, fusion survival, assay rate, integrated display, or process cost has been measured. The accompanying Python is arithmetic only and was not executed.
contract.units: Source-local purity/recovery fractions p,t,w; no physical rate or throughput units supplied.
contract.obstruction: This is downstream culling after whole-product synthesis, not product-gated progression at every step, perfect on-ribosome correction, a validated molecular assembler, or a practical-advantage claim.

evidence.range_scope: Mechanism proposal, exact selectivity arithmetic, costs, fair comparators, and decisive unacquired compatibility tests.
evidence.status: Exact selected original bytes; this intake preserves and indexes the passage.
evidence.quote: Specific chemistry: initial program = distinct mRNA_j; reusable catalyst = shared ribosome and translation proteins; monomers = flexizyme-loaded diester/hydrazinoester tRNAs, already shown to generate programmed hydrazinedione ring.

evidence.range_scope: Existing ribosomal cyclic-backbone chemistry, genotype/display linkage, and cited comparator credits as reported by the selected source.
evidence.status: Exact selected original bytes; this intake preserves and indexes the passage.

evidence.range_scope: Selected governing statement, construction, conditions or credit; not whole-compendium acceptance.
evidence.quote: Mixing two different diesters charged to the same tRNA species or decoded by the same codon does not provide individually selectable instructions

body: After complete synthesis, the source proposes removing a subset of wrong products based on a chemical state that is absent from the desired ring. This differs from gating each assembly step. The 22% substrate-specific example implies a >=351-fold relative wrong/correct discrimination for 99% post-filter purity, but the report has no acquired compatible capture/display result and other substrates may cyclize more efficiently.

review.scope: Reviewed mechanism proposal for downstream qualification of a finished genotype-linked library, not acquired selective capture/display or step-by-step product gating. RNA compatibility, selective chemistry, distinguishable decoding registers and integrated performance remain open. The 22% substrate example is not the double-ring experiment.
